label: snow
description: precipitation in the form of ice crystal flakes

label: winter
description: one of the Earth's four temperate seasons, occurring between autumn and spring; one of the 8 Sámi seasons

label: night
description: period from sunset to sunrise in each twenty-four hours

label: moon
description: Earth's only natural satellite

label: moonlight
description: light that reaches Earth from the Moon

label: seascape
description: form of figurative art that portrays or draws its main inspiration from the sea

label: genre art
description: art genre that depicts scenes from everyday life

label: history painting
description: genre in painting defined by historical matter (see also religious painting and mythological painting)

label: religious art
description: genre of art that is religious in theme

label: harbor
description: sheltered body of water where ships, boats, and barges can be docked

label: beach
description: area of sand or small stones near the sea or another area of water such as a lake

label: street
description: public thoroughfare in a built environment like a village or city

label: mountain
description: large natural elevation of the Earth's surface

label: forest
description: subjective characterization of an area with trees

label: field
description: area of land used for agricultural purposes

label: cattle
description: large, domesticated, cloven-hooved herbivores

label: sheep
description: domesticated ruminant bred for meat, wool, and milk

label: dog
description: domesticated mammal of the family Canidae

label: man
description: male adult human

label: girl
description: young female human

label: boy
description: young male human

label: fruit
description: typically sweet and/or sour, edible part/s of a plant that resembles seed-bearing fruit

label: fog
description: atmospheric phenomenon

label: bridge
description: structure that spans and provides a passage over a road, railway, river, or some other obstacle

label: windmill
description: machine that converts the energy of wind into rotational energy by means of adjustable sails

label: garden
description: planned space set aside for the display, cultivation and enjoyment of plants

label: nude
description: art genre for works that have as their primary subject the unclothed human body
